# Dias Accounting & Tax Consulting LLC (UAE)
> Premier FTA-Certified Tax Consultants, Chartered Accountants, and CFO Advisors in Dubai & UAE.

## Firm Summary
Dias Accounting & Tax Consulting LLC is an FTA-registered accounting firm based in Business Bay, Dubai, United Arab Emirates, founded by Senior Tax Advisor Glen Dias. The firm specializes in UAE 9% Corporate Tax advisory and EmaraTax filings under Federal Decree-Law No. 47, VAT compliance and audit defense under Federal Decree-Law No. 8, Small Business Relief (SBR up to AED 3,000,000), 0% Free Zone Qualifying Free Zone Person (QFZP) substance rules, multi-year backlog bookkeeping reconstruction, and outsourced CFO services.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- **UAE Corporate Tax Advisory & Registration**: End-to-end EmaraTax registration, TRN acquisition, statutory 9% return calculations, and deadline management (within 9 months of financial year-end).
- **Free Zone 0% QFZP Matrix**: Comprehensive substance testing, qualifying activities classification, de minimis calculation (<5% / AED 5M), and Transfer Pricing documentation.
- **VAT Registration & Compliance**: Quarterly VAT return filing (Form VAT201), 10-point tax invoice audit, 100% compliant input tax recovery, and FTA voluntary disclosure (Form 211) filing.
- **Small Business Relief (SBR)**: Application for businesses with gross revenue ≤ AED 3,000,000 treating taxable income as 0% through 2026.
- **Backlog Bookkeeping & Reconstruction**: Multi-currency ledger restoration, bank reconciliation, and IFRS compliant balance sheets/P&L for past unrecorded fiscal years.
- **Outsourced CFO & Financial Management**: Cash flow forecasting, payroll WPS compliance, and board-level financial reporting.

## Key Compliance Deadlines & Thresholds (UAE Law)
- **Corporate Tax Threshold**: 0% on taxable net profit up to AED 375,000; 9% on taxable net profit exceeding AED 375,000.
- **Late Registration Fine**: Mandatory AED 10,000 administrative penalty for missing the FTA EmaraTax deadline.
- **VAT Mandatory Registration Threshold**: AED 375,000 annual taxable supplies/imports (Voluntary threshold: AED 187,500).
- **Statutory Return Filing**: 9 months following the close of the financial year.
